title: Central Bank Liquidity Backstops, Bank Regulation, and Risk-Taking by Asset Managers
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro; Wenqian Huang; Nikola A. Tarashev
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD, not staggered. 02_code/AHT_MS_Tables.do lines 65-66 and 117: post18 = date > 31 Dec 2017 (post15 = date > 31 Dec 2014 in the placebo/alternative year) for every fund, interacted with d_high_ras_fund_17 (prime money market funds with a high risky-asset share in 2017). Table 1 regresses risky_as_share on d_high_ras_fund_17, post18 and their product with fund size and WAM controls (plus QE and CP-market controls), with no FE, fund-type FE, fund FE or date and fund FE; Table 2 regresses daily WAM on prime##post18 with lagged assets and flow controls. Figures 3/RR1 are single-date event studies (i.mdate##hr17) with controls. One adoption date per design.
design_notes: Stata 18 reghdfe; 02_code/AHT_MS_Tables.do and AHT_MS_Figures.do; data 01_data/All.dta (monthly MMF holdings) and Crane_daily.dta (daily fund data). Cluster by fund. Theoretical model in the paper.
data_files_note: ReadMe: the package contains all data, codes and outputs; All.dta (Table 1) and Crane_daily.dta (Table 2).
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). Single regulatory date (end-2017) with treated/control funds; excluded as not staggered.
